Description
The SZSMF6L series is designed to protect sensitive systems or
components from high voltage, high energy transients. It offers a
fast response time, low Zener impedance, high surge and excellent
clamping capabilities. Because of its small size, it is ideal for use in
automotive electronics applications.

■ Automotive grade, AEC-Q101 ■ ESD rating of class 3 (> 16 KV)

qualified and PPAP-capable per human body model
